map.以三爻经卦两两相重（下卦×上卦）得六爻别卦，共 8×8=64 种。每卦有固定卦序: Each trigram is doubled by combining lower and upper trigrams (lower × upper) to form the six-line different hexagrams, giving 8×8=64 in total. Each hexagram has a fixed position in the sequence (the order in the received text of the Zhou Yi or the Jing Fang eight-palace order) together with its name and judgement, and this is the basis of Zhou Yi divination and meaning studies.

map.起卦后查卦：由三枚铜钱或蓍草得出六爻（自下而上初至上），对照六十四卦表读取卦名、: Looking up the hexagram after casting: derive the six lines from three coins or yarrow stalks (from the bottom up, first line to top), then consult the sixty-four hexagram table for the name, the order and the upper/lower trigram combination.

map.：乾卦为六十四卦第 1 卦（卦序 1），上下皆乾（☰），六爻皆阳，卦辞“元亨利贞: : the Qian hexagram is the first of the sixty-four (order 1), with upper and lower both Qian (☰), all six lines yang, and the judgement "yuan, heng, li, zhen", symbolising strength and vitality. Its inverse is Kun (☷, all six lines yin) and its reverse is Qian itself (self-symmetric); changing the first line gives Heaven over Wind, Gou. Consulting the table quickly locates the name, the order, the upper and lower trigrams and the basic verdict.
